-- RNGHandler: rolling + equipping shovels. Data lives in DataService.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RollRNG")
-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): everyone hears about very rare rolls (banner + aura on each client, see RareAnnounceClient)
local announce = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RareRollAnnounce") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
announce.Name = "RareRollAnnounce"
announce.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local getInventory = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetInventory")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipShovel")

local MAX_EQUIPPED = (Config.MaxEquipped or 2) + 1 -- absolute max (with the 3rd Shovel upgrade)
local function slotsFor(player) return player:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or Config.MaxEquipped or 2 end
local lastRoll, lastEquip = {}, {}

-- rarest first, each at its own "1 in N"
local sorted = table.clone(Config.Items)
table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.Chance > b.Chance end)
local function roll(luck)
	luck = luck or 1
	for _, item in ipairs(sorted) do
		if item.Chance > 1 and math.random() < luck / item.Chance then return item.Name end
	end
	return sorted[#sorted].Name
end

-- Mutations (2026-10-01): each rolled shovel independently can be Shiny (1 in 10) and/or Giant (1 in 5).
local function mutate(name)
	local ids = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations or {}) do
		if math.random() < 1 / m.Chance then table.insert(ids, m.Id) end
	end
	return #ids > 0 and Config.VariantName(name, ids) or name
end

local function copies(list, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

-- equipped list is published as an attribute; clients draw the spinner from it
local function publish(player, d)
	player:SetAttribute("EquippedShovels", table.concat(d.Equipped, ","))
end

local function sanitize(d)
	local clean = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(d.Equipped) do
		if Config.ByName[name] and copies(clean, name) < (d.Counts[name] or 0) and #clean < MAX_EQUIPPED then
			table.insert(clean, name)
		end
	end
	d.Equipped = clean
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player, d)
	sanitize(d)
	publish(player, d)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastRoll[player] = nil
	lastEquip[player] = nil
end)

getInventory.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	return d and {Counts = d.Counts, Equipped = d.Equipped}
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	if require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PlowConfig")).Mode == "Snowplow" then return end -- 2026-10-04 (Claude): snowplows replace the old shovel rolls (set PlowConfig.Mode = "Legacy" to restore it)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastRoll[player] and now - lastRoll[player] < Config.RollCooldown * (player:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1) then return end
	lastRoll[player] = now

	-- luck = base (admin/events) x LuckMult (upgrade %s, rebirths, friends). Shovels give power, not luck (2026-10-01).
	local luck = (d.Luck or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("TotalLuck", luck)
	-- Golden / Rainbow dice (2026-10-01): every Nth lifetime roll gets a luck boost; Rainbow wins when both land.
	local rollNumber = (d.TotalRolls or 0) + 1
	local special
	local rainbowEvery = math.floor(player:GetAttribute("RainbowEvery") or 0)
	local goldenEvery = math.floor(player:GetAttribute("GoldenEvery") or 0)
	if rainbowEvery > 0 and rollNumber % rainbowEvery == 0 then
		special = "Rainbow"
		luck *= player:GetAttribute("RainbowLuck") or 10
	elseif goldenEvery > 0 and rollNumber % goldenEvery == 0 then
		special = "Golden"
		luck *= player:GetAttribute("GoldenLuck") or 3
	end
	local result = mutate(roll(luck))
	d.Counts[result] = (d.Counts[result] or 0) + 1
	d.TotalRolls += 1
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Rolls", d.TotalRolls)

	if #d.Equipped == 0 then
		table.insert(d.Equipped, result)
		task.delay(3.8, function()
			if DataService.Get(player) == d then publish(player, d) end
		end)
	end

	-- Double Roll upgrade: chance for a bonus shovel
	local extra
	if math.random() < (player:GetAttribute("DoubleRollChance") or 0) then
		extra = mutate(roll(luck))
		d.Counts[extra] = (d.Counts[extra] or 0) + 1
	end
	remote:FireClient(player, result, d.Counts, d.Equipped, luck, extra, special)
	for _, got in ipairs({result, extra}) do
		local won = Config.ByName[got]
		if won and won.Chance >= ((Config.RareDrop and Config.RareDrop.AnnounceChance) or 10000) then
			announce:FireAllClients(player.Name, got, won.Chance)
		end
	end
end)

equipRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, name)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return nil end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastEquip[player] and now - lastEquip[player] < 0.25 then return d.Equipped end
	lastEquip[player] = now
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not Config.ByName[name] then return d.Equipped end

	if action == "equip" then
		if copies(d.Equipped, name) < (d.Counts[name] or 0) then
			if #d.Equipped >= slotsFor(player) then table.remove(d.Equipped, 1) end
			table.insert(d.Equipped, name)
		end
	elseif action == "unequip" then
		for i = #d.Equipped, 1, -1 do
			if d.Equipped[i] == name then table.remove(d.Equipped, i) break end
		end
	end
	publish(player, d)
	return d.Equipped
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- LIVE LUCK for the HUD: TotalLuck = base x LuckMult (upgrade %s, rebirths, friends)
--------------------------------------------------
local function updateLuck(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	local upgrades = player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1
	player:SetAttribute("LuckShovels", 1) -- shovels give no luck; kept for older UI
	player:SetAttribute("LuckBase", d.Luck or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("TotalLuck", (d.Luck or 1) * upgrades)
end
DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	updateLuck(player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LuckMult"):Connect(function() updateLuck(player) end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedShovels"):Connect(function() updateLuck(player) end)
end)
task.spawn(function() -- catches admin ;luck changes etc.
	while true do
		task.wait(2)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do updateLuck(p) end
	end
end)

-- PetService: opening eggs (ProximityPrompt), owning & equipping pets. Everything validated here.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local hatchedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetHatched")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
local getPets = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetPets")

local MAX = PetConfig.MaxEquipped + 2 -- absolute max (with the +1 Pet Equip upgrades)
local function slotsFor(player) return player:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or PetConfig.MaxEquipped end
local HATCH_COOLDOWN = 2.2
local lastHatch, lastEquip = {}, {}

local function copies(list, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local function publish(player, d)
	player:SetAttribute("EquippedPets", table.concat(d.EquippedPets, ","))
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player, d)
	local clean = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(d.EquippedPets) do
		if PetConfig.PetByName[name] and copies(clean, name) < (d.Pets[name] or 0) and #clean < MAX then
			table.insert(clean, name)
		end
	end
	d.EquippedPets = clean
	publish(player, d)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastHatch[p] = nil; lastEquip[p] = nil end)

local function rollPet(egg)
	local total = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do total += p.Chance end
	local r = math.random() * total
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		r -= p.Chance
		if r <= 0 then return p end
	end
	return egg.Pets[1]
end

local function hatch(player, egg, eggPart)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	-- 2026-10-02 (Claude): Cost-0 stages (World 2 Sakura) open through the previous stage, so d.Stages has no entry for them.
	-- StageService sets Stage_<Id> on the server from the same profile (client changes never replicate back).
	if egg.RequiredStage and egg.RequiredStage ~= "Starter" and d.Stages[egg.RequiredStage] ~= true
		and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. egg.RequiredStage) ~= true then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp or (hrp.Position - eggPart.Position).Magnitude > 20 then return end
	local cost = math.floor(egg.Cost * (1 - (player:GetAttribute("EggDiscount") or 0)) + 0.5)
	if d.Snow < cost then
		hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "NotEnough", egg.Id, cost)
		return
	end
	lastHatch[player] = now
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -cost)
	local pet = rollPet(egg)
	local isNew = not d.PetIndex[pet.Name]
	d.PetIndex[pet.Name] = true
	d.Pets[pet.Name] = (d.Pets[pet.Name] or 0) + 1
	if #d.EquippedPets < slotsFor(player) then
		table.insert(d.EquippedPets, pet.Name)
		task.delay(2.5, function() if DataService.Get(player) == d then publish(player, d) end end)
	end
	hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "Hatched", egg.Id, pet.Name, isNew, d.Pets, d.EquippedPets, d.PetIndex)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- EGG PROMPTS + ODDS SIGNS
--------------------------------------------------
local function rarityHex(r)
	local c = PetConfig.Rarities[r] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", c.R * 255, c.G * 255, c.B * 255)
end

local function setupEgg(model, egg)
	if model:GetAttribute("EggReady") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("EggReady", true)
	local main = model.PrimaryPart
	if not main then
		local biggest = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Size.Magnitude > biggest then biggest = p.Size.Magnitude; main = p end
		end
	end
	if not main then return end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "HatchPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Open (" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(egg.Cost) .. " ❄)"
	prompt.ObjectText = egg.Name
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = main
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) hatch(player, egg, main) end)

	-- the odds sign is drawn by each client (PetClient) so undiscovered pets can be silhouettes
end

local function scan()
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Model") and PetConfig.EggById[d.Name] then setupEgg(d, PetConfig.EggById[d.Name]) end
	end
end
scan()
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if d:IsA("Model") and PetConfig.EggById[d.Name] then task.defer(setupEgg, d, PetConfig.EggById[d.Name]) end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- REMOTES
--------------------------------------------------
getPets.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	return d and {Pets = d.Pets, Equipped = d.EquippedPets, Index = d.PetIndex}
end

equipRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, name)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return nil end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastEquip[player] and now - lastEquip[player] < 0.25 then return d.EquippedPets end
	lastEquip[player] = now
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not PetConfig.PetByName[name] then return d.EquippedPets end
	if action == "equip" then
		if copies(d.EquippedPets, name) < (d.Pets[name] or 0) then
			if #d.EquippedPets >= slotsFor(player) then table.remove(d.EquippedPets, 1) end
			table.insert(d.EquippedPets, name)
		end
	elseif action == "unequip" then
		for i = #d.EquippedPets, 1, -1 do
			if d.EquippedPets[i] == name then table.remove(d.EquippedPets, i) break end
		end
	end
	publish(player, d)
	return d.EquippedPets
end

-- SettingsService: saves simple per-player settings and publishes them as player attributes.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local setSetting = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SetSetting")

-- allowed settings and their default values
local ALLOWED = {MusicOn = true, TutorialDone = false}

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player, d)
	for key, default in pairs(ALLOWED) do
		local v = d.Settings[key]
		if v == nil then v = default end
		player:SetAttribute(key, v)
	end
end)

setSetting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, key, value)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d or ALLOWED[key] == nil or type(value) ~= type(ALLOWED[key]) then return end
	d.Settings[key] = value
	player:SetAttribute(key, value)
end)

-- Pure server-side transaction rules; no yields occur between validation and reset.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Shovels = require(RS:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Pets = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local Stages = require(RS:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local Upgrades = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local Rules = {}

function Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not d then return false, "Your progress is still loading." end
 if type(expected) ~= "number" or expected ~= R.Count(d.Rebirths) then
  return false, "Your rebirth changed. Check the rewards and try again."
 end
 local req = R.Requirement(d.Rebirths)
 if not req then return false, "You reached the maximum rebirth level!" end
 -- 2026-10-04 (Claude): no stage requirement any more - a rebirth only needs the Snow cost (RebirthConfig.Milestones[].Cost)
 if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow == math.huge or d.Snow < req.Cost then
  return false, "You need more Snow to rebirth."
 end
 return true, req
end

local function equippedAfterReset(list, owned, byName, slots, score)
 local clean, used = {}, {}
 for _, name in ipairs(list or {}) do
  if byName[name] and (used[name] or 0) < (owned[name] or 0) then
   used[name] = (used[name] or 0) + 1
   table.insert(clean, name)
  end
 end
 table.sort(clean, function(a, b) return score(byName[a]) > score(byName[b]) end)
 while #clean > slots do table.remove(clean) end
 return clean
end

function Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 local ok, req = Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, req end
 -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): upgrades are KEPT on rebirth (user request), so the equip slots they give stay too.
 -- Compute the new equipped sets before changing the profile.
 local kept = Upgrades.Calculate(d.Upgrades or {}, 0)
 local equipped = equippedAfterReset(d.Equipped, d.Counts, Shovels.ByName, kept.ShovelSlots or Upgrades.Base.ShovelSlots, function(x) return x.Chance end)
 local pets = equippedAfterReset(d.EquippedPets, d.Pets, Pets.PetByName, kept.PetSlots or Upgrades.Base.PetSlots, function(x) return x.Boost end)
 d.Rebirths = req.Level
 d.Snow = 0
 d.Stages = {}
 -- d.Upgrades is kept (2026-10-03; it used to be reset here)
 d.Equipped = equipped
 d.EquippedPets = pets
 -- Upgrades, Counts, Pets, PetIndex, Settings, TotalRolls and base luck are preserved.
 return true, req
end
return Rules

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local D = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Rules = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RebirthRules"))
local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local StageConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local U = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local request = RS:WaitForChild("RequestRebirth")
local refreshed = RS:WaitForChild("DataRefresh")
local cooldown = {}

local function publish(player, d)
 local snow, luck = R.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", R.Count(d.Rebirths))
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthSnowMult", snow)
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult", luck)
 D.SetStat(player, "Rebirths", R.Count(d.Rebirths))
end
D.OnLoaded(publish)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) cooldown[p] = nil end)

request.OnServerInvoke = function(player, expected)
 local now = os.clock()
 if cooldown[player] and now - cooldown[player] < 1 then return false, "Please wait a moment." end
 cooldown[player] = now
 local d = D.Get(player)
 local char = player.Character
 local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false, "Wait until your character has respawned." end
 local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
 if not spawn then return false, "The spawn point is unavailable. Please try again." end
 local ok, result = Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, result end

 -- Reset replicated gameplay state immediately, before any further collection ticks.
 local stats = U.Calculate(d.Upgrades, player:GetAttribute("FriendsHere") or 0)
 local snow, luck = R.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 stats.SnowMult *= snow
 stats.LuckMult *= luck
 for k, v in pairs(stats) do player:SetAttribute(k, v) end
 for id in pairs(U.ById) do player:SetAttribute("Up_" .. id, d.Upgrades[id] == true) end -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): upgrades are kept on rebirth
 for _, s in ipairs(StageConfig.Order) do player:SetAttribute("Stage_" .. s.Id, s.Id == "Starter") end
 player:SetAttribute("EquippedShovels", table.concat(d.Equipped, ","))
 player:SetAttribute("EquippedPets", table.concat(d.EquippedPets, ","))
 hum.WalkSpeed = stats.WalkSpeed
 D.SetStat(player, "Snow", 0)
 publish(player, d)
 -- 2026-10-04 (Claude): a rebirth always brings you back to World 1. Reset the World attribute (otherwise every respawn sends you to
 -- the now-locked World 2 plaza) and load the spawn area first, like the World 2 portal does (StreamingEnabled is on).
 player:SetAttribute("World", 1)
 pcall(function() player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(spawn.Position, 8) end)
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
 char:PivotTo(spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, spawn.Size.Y / 2 + 4, 0))
 SS.AdminHooks.ReapplyUpgrades:Fire(player)
 SS.AdminHooks.ReapplyStages:Fire(player)
 refreshed:FireClient(player)
 task.spawn(D.Save, player)
 return true, "Rebirth complete! Your permanent bonuses are active."
end

-- PlowRegistry (2026-10-04, Claude): the live snowplow of each driving player. PlowService writes it, SnowFieldService reads it.
return {Active = {}}

-- PlowRules (2026-10-04, Claude): validates / repairs data.Plow when a profile loads (called from DataService.defaults), like StarterShovelRules.
-- Existing profiles keep everything they had; the starter loadout is added; unknown or tampered values are dropped.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
local Rules = {}
local function cleanOffer(o)
	if type(o) ~= "table" or type(o.Part) ~= "string" or not C.Parts[o.Part] or type(o.Token) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local price = tonumber(o.Price)
	if not price or price ~= price or price < 0 then price = C.Parts[o.Part].Price end
	return {Part = o.Part, Token = o.Token, Price = price, Seq = tonumber(o.Seq) or 0}
end
function Rules.Apply(d)
	local p = type(d.Plow) == "table" and d.Plow or {}
	d.Plow = p
	local fresh = type(p.Build) ~= "table"
	local parts = {}
	if type(p.Parts) == "table" then
		for id, n in pairs(p.Parts) do
			if type(id) == "string" and C.Parts[id] and type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 1 then parts[id] = math.min(math.floor(n), C.Shop.MaxOwned) end
		end
	end
	for _, id in pairs(C.Starter) do if not parts[id] then parts[id] = 1 end end
	p.Parts = parts
	local build = {}
	if fresh then
		for slot, id in pairs(C.Starter) do build[slot] = id end
	else
		for _, slot in ipairs(C.Slots) do
			local id = p.Build[slot]
			if type(id) == "string" and C.Parts[id] and C.Parts[id].Slot == slot and parts[id] then build[slot] = id end
		end
	end
	p.Build = build
	local offers, src = {}, type(p.Offers) == "table" and p.Offers or {}
	for _, k in ipairs({"1", "2", "3"}) do offers[k] = cleanOffer(src[k]) end
	if not offers["1"] then offers["1"] = cleanOffer(p.Offer) end -- an old single offer moves to pedestal 1
	p.Offers, p.Offer = offers, nil
	p.Reserved = cleanOffer(p.Reserved)
	p.Seq = (type(p.Seq) == "number" and p.Seq == p.Seq) and math.floor(p.Seq) or 0
	p.Rolls = (type(p.Rolls) == "number" and p.Rolls == p.Rolls) and math.floor(p.Rolls) or 0
	p.TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true
	return d
end
return Rules

-- PlowService (2026-10-04, Claude): server side of the snowplow loop.
--   * personal part offers (roll / buy / reserve / reroll), owned parts and the selected build - saved through DataService (data.Plow)
--   * garage equip / unequip, and the vehicle itself (spawn at a safe spot, seat, cleanup, recover)
--   * field clearing is done by SnowFieldService from the vehicle registered in PlowRegistry
-- Every request is validated here; clients only ask. Studio tests: ServerStorage.BalanceTestMode = true.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
if C.Mode ~= "Snowplow" then return end
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Registry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlowRegistry"))
local Assembly = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowAssembly"))
local Format = require(RS:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local TEST = RunService:IsStudio() and SS:GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true
if TEST then RS:SetAttribute("PlowTestHooks", true) end
local rng = Random.new()

local function remote(class, name)
	local r = RS:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = RS end
	return r
end
local fn, ev = remote("RemoteFunction", "PlowRemote"), remote("RemoteEvent", "PlowEvent")
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Snowplows") or Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Snowplows"; folder.Parent = workspace

-- vehicles never block other players: vehicles and characters live in groups that do not collide with each other
for _, name in ipairs({"PlowVehicle", "PlowPlayers"}) do pcall(function() PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name) end) end
pcall(function() PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("PlowVehicle", "PlowPlayers", false) end)
local function groupCharacter(char)
	for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CollisionGroup = "PlowPlayers" end end
	char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CollisionGroup = "PlowPlayers" end end)
end
local function watchPlayer(pl)
	pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(groupCharacter)
	if pl.Character then groupCharacter(pl.Character) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(pl) end

local RANK = {}
for i, r in ipairs(C.Rarities) do RANK[r.Id] = i end

local function snapshot(player, d)
	local p = d.Plow
	local function pub(o) if not o then return nil end return {Part = o.Part, Token = o.Token, Price = o.Price} end
	local parts = {}
	for id, n in pairs(p.Parts) do parts[id] = n end
	return {Mode = C.Mode, Parts = parts, Build = {Blade = p.Build.Blade, Engine = p.Build.Engine, Gear = p.Build.Gear},
		Offers = {["1"] = pub(p.Offers["1"]), ["2"] = pub(p.Offers["2"]), ["3"] = pub(p.Offers["3"])}, Reserved = pub(p.Reserved), InGarage = player:GetAttribute("InGarage") == true, Snow = d.Snow, Cooldown = math.max(0, (cooldown[player] or 0) - os.clock()),
		Driving = Registry.Active[player] ~= nil, TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true}
end
local function pickPart(player, d)
	local luck = math.max(1, (tonumber(d.Luck) or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1))
	local ids = {}
	for id, def in pairs(C.Parts) do if def.Weight > 0 then table.insert(ids, id) end end
	table.sort(ids)
	local w, total = {}, 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local def = C.Parts[id]
		w[id] = def.Weight * luck ^ (C.Shop.LuckExponent * math.max(0, RANK[def.Rarity] - 2))
		total += w[id]
	end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do r -= w[id]; if r <= 0 then return id end end
	return ids[#ids]
end

local function mods(player)
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local ws = hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16
	return {PowerMult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1, PowerBonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0, SizeMult = player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1,
		ReachMult = player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1, SpinMult = player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1, SpeedMult = 1 + math.clamp(ws / 16 - 1, 0, 1) * 0.5}
end
local function flat(v, fallback)
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	return f.Magnitude > 0.1 and f.Unit or fallback
end
local function findSpawn(char)
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local look = flat(hrp.CFrame.LookVector, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	local rp = RaycastParams.new(); rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
	local op = OverlapParams.new(); op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; op.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
	local best
	for _, ang in ipairs({0, 40, -40, 80, -80, 125, -125, 180}) do
		local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ang), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(look)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + dir * C.Vehicle.SpawnAhead + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rp)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.9 then
			local pos = hit.Position
			local center = pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
			local blocked = false
			for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.lookAt(center, center + dir), Vector3.new(7.5, 3.4, 11), op)) do
				if part.CanCollide then blocked = true break end
			end
			local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dir)
			if not blocked then return cf end
			best = best or cf
		end
	end
	local p0 = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0) + look * 6
	return best or CFrame.lookAt(p0, p0 + look)
end

local despawn
local function recover(player, v)
	local hull = v.hull
	if not hull or not hull.Parent then return end
	local cf = v.safeCF or hull.CFrame
	local look = flat(cf.LookVector, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	local pos = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	pcall(function() hull:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
	v.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look))
	hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hull.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	v.lastCF, v.flipSince = nil, nil
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		if hull.Parent and Registry.Active[player] == v then pcall(function() hull:SetNetworkOwner(player) end) end
	end)
end
function despawn(player, reason)
	local v = Registry.Active[player]
	if not v then return end
	Registry.Active[player] = nil
	for _, c in ipairs(v.conns or {}) do c:Disconnect() end
	player:SetAttribute("PlowDriving", false)
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.SeatPart == v.seat then hum.Sit = false end
	if v.model then v.model:Destroy() end
	ev:FireClient(player, "Despawned", reason)
end
local function spawnVehicle(player, d, p)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0) then return fail("Wait until you respawn.") end
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return fail("Finish the intro first!") end
	if hum.SeatPart then return fail("You're already sitting somewhere.") end
	local build = p.Build
	if not (build.Engine and build.Gear) then return fail("Your snowplow needs an engine and running gear - open the GARAGE!") end
	local stats = C.StatsFor(build, mods(player))
	local rootCF = findSpawn(char)
	local ok, model = pcall(Assembly.Build, build)
	if not ok or not model then return fail("The snowplow parts are missing - tell the developer.") end
	model.Name = "Snowplow_" .. player.UserId
	model:PivotTo(rootCF)
	local seatRel = model:GetAttribute("SeatPos")
	local hs = C.Vehicle.HullSize
	local hull = Instance.new("Part")
	hull.Name = "Hull"; hull.Size = hs; hull.Transparency = 1
	hull.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, C.Vehicle.HullClearance + hs.Y / 2, 0)
	hull.CanCollide, hull.CanQuery, hull.CanTouch = true, false, false
	hull.CollisionGroup = "PlowVehicle"
	hull.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.6, 0, 0, 100, 1)
	hull.Parent = model
	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "DriverSeat"; seat.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 0.6, 2.4); seat.Transparency = 1
	seat.CanCollide, seat.CanQuery, seat.CanTouch = false, false, false
	seat.CFrame = model.PrimaryPart.CFrame * (seatRel or CFrame.new(0, 3, 1)) * CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 0)
	seat.Parent = model
	local function weld(part)
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Part0 = hull; w.Part1 = part; w.Parent = part
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hull then
			part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery, part.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
			weld(part)
		end
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = hull
	hull.Anchored = false
	hull:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	hull:SetAttribute("MaxSpeed", stats.MaxSpeed); hull:SetAttribute("Accel", stats.Accel); hull:SetAttribute("TurnRate", stats.TurnRate)
	hull:SetAttribute("Traction", stats.Traction); hull:SetAttribute("Stability", stats.Stability); hull:SetAttribute("Pivot", stats.Pivot)
	model.Parent = folder
	local v = {model = model, hull = hull, seat = seat, stats = stats, build = {Blade = build.Blade, Engine = build.Engine, Gear = build.Gear},
		safeCF = hull.CFrame, spawnedAt = os.clock(), flags = 0, conns = {}}
	Registry.Active[player] = v
	player:SetAttribute("PlowDriving", true)
	table.insert(v.conns, hum.Died:Connect(function() despawn(player, "died") end))
	seat:Sit(hum)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.0 and hum.SeatPart ~= seat and Registry.Active[player] == v do task.wait(0.05) end
	if Registry.Active[player] ~= v then return fail("Couldn't hop in - try again.") end
	if hum.SeatPart ~= seat then despawn(player, "seat failed"); return fail("Couldn't hop in - try again.") end
	pcall(function() hull:SetNetworkOwner(player) end)
	table.insert(v.conns, hum.Seated:Connect(function(active) if not active then task.defer(despawn, player, "exit") end end))
	ev:FireClient(player, "Spawned")
	return {ok = true, driving = true}
end

local actions = {}
function actions.State() return {ok = true} end
local SLOTS = {["1"] = true, ["2"] = true, ["3"] = true}
function actions.Roll(player, d, p, slot)
	slot = tostring(slot or "1")
	if not SLOTS[slot] then return fail("Bad request") end
	if not player:GetAttribute("InGarage") then return fail("Parts are rolled on the pedestals in the GARAGE - tap GARAGE to teleport there!") end
	if (cooldown[player] or 0) > os.clock() then return fail("Rolling too fast - one moment!") end
	cooldown[player] = os.clock() + C.Shop.RollCooldown
	local id = pickPart(player, d)
	p.Seq += 1
	p.Rolls += 1
	p.Offers[slot] = {Part = id, Token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), Price = C.Parts[id].Price, Seq = p.Seq}
	player:SetAttribute("PlowOffered", true)
	return {ok = true, rolled = true, slot = slot, rank = RANK[C.Parts[id].Rarity]}
end
actions.Reroll = actions.Roll
function actions.Buy(player, d, p, which, token)
	if which ~= "Reserved" and not SLOTS[which] then return fail("Bad request") end
	local o = which == "Reserved" and p.Reserved or p.Offers[which]
	if type(token) ~= "string" or not o or o.Token ~= token then return fail("That offer is gone - roll a new one!", {stale = true}) end
	local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
	if not def then
		if which == "Reserved" then p.Reserved = nil else p.Offers[which] = nil end
		return fail("That part no longer exists.")
	end
	local price = o.Price
	if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow < price then
		local short = math.ceil(price - (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0))
		return fail("You need " .. Format.Abbreviate(short) .. " more Snow", {short = short})
	end
	if (p.Parts[o.Part] or 0) >= C.Shop.MaxOwned then return fail("You own the maximum of this part.") end
	-- deduct + grant + clear in one step (no yield in between): a duplicate or forged request can never buy twice
	d.Snow -= price
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
	p.Parts[o.Part] = (p.Parts[o.Part] or 0) + 1
	if which == "Reserved" then p.Reserved = nil else p.Offers[which] = nil end
	player:SetAttribute("PlowBought", true)
	return {ok = true, bought = o.Part, msg = "Bought " .. def.Name .. "!"}
end
function actions.Reserve(player, d, p, slot, token, confirm)
	slot = tostring(slot or "")
	if not SLOTS[slot] then return fail("Bad request") end
	local o = p.Offers[slot]
	if type(token) ~= "string" or not o or o.Token ~= token then return fail("That offer is gone - roll a new one!", {stale = true}) end
	if p.Reserved and confirm ~= true then return fail("Replace your reserved part?", {needConfirm = true}) end
	p.Reserved = o
	p.Offers[slot] = nil
	return {ok = true, msg = "Reserved " .. C.Parts[o.Part].Name .. "!"}
end
function actions.Equip(player, d, p, slot, id)
	if type(slot) ~= "string" or type(id) ~= "string" then return fail("Bad request") end
	local def = C.Parts[id]
	if not def or def.Slot ~= slot or not table.find(C.Slots, slot) then return fail("That part doesn't fit that slot.") end
	if (p.Parts[id] or 0) < 1 then return fail("You don't own that part.") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then return fail("Park your snowplow first (EXIT), then change parts.") end
	p.Build[slot] = id
	player:SetAttribute("PlowEquipped", true)
	return {ok = true, msg = def.Name .. " equipped!"}
end
function actions.Unequip(player, d, p, slot)
	if type(slot) ~= "string" or not table.find(C.Slots, slot) then return fail("Bad request") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then return fail("Park your snowplow first (EXIT), then change parts.") end
	p.Build[slot] = nil
	return {ok = true, msg = "Unequipped - the part stays in your inventory."}
end
function actions.Drive(player, d, p)
	if player:GetAttribute("InGarage") then return fail("Go back to the lobby to drive - tap LOBBY!") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then despawn(player, "exit"); return {ok = true, driving = false} end
	return spawnVehicle(player, d, p)
end
function actions.Recover(player)
	local v = Registry.Active[player]
	if not v then return fail("You're not driving.") end
	if (v.recoverAt or 0) > os.clock() then return fail("Recover is cooling down...") end
	v.recoverAt = os.clock() + C.Vehicle.RecoverCooldown
	recover(player, v)
	return {ok = true, msg = "Snowplow recovered!"}
end
function actions.TutorialDone(player, d, p) p.TutorialDone = true; return {ok = true} end

local function handle(player, action, a, b, c)
	if type(action) ~= "string" then return fail("Bad request") end
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d or not d.Plow then return fail("Your data is still loading...") end
	if action ~= "State" then
		if (lastCall[player] or 0) > os.clock() - 0.05 then return fail("Slow down!") end

	end
	local handler = actions[action]
	if not handler then return fail("Unknown action") end
	local ok, res = pcall(handler, player, d, d.Plow, a, b, c)
	if not ok then warn("[PlowService] " .. action .. ": " .. tostring(res)); return fail("Something went wrong - try again.") end
	if type(res) == "table" then res.state = snapshot(player, d) end
	return res
end

-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- Every shovel arm that sweeps over a tile deals its Power as damage; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local treasureModule = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("TreasureService")
local okTreasures, Treasures = false, nil
if treasureModule then okTreasures, Treasures = pcall(require, treasureModule) end
if not okTreasures then warn("[SnowFieldService] TreasureService unavailable: " .. tostring(Treasures)); Treasures = nil end
local treasureWarned = false
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local SPEED = SF.Spinner.Speed
local R_IN, R_OUT = SF.Spinner.Inner, SF.Spinner.Outer
local HUB = 1.6 -- grip ring radius (ShovelOrbit INNER); a Giant shovel doubles the reach beyond it
local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

local lastTime = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
	lastTime[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- damage and size per arm, from each equipped shovel (Giant mutation = Size 2)
local function armPowers(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels")
	local list, sizes = {}, {}
	if not attr or attr == "" then return list, sizes end
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		table.insert(list, item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1)
		table.insert(sizes, item and item.Size or 1)
	end
	return list, sizes
end

-- Dig combo (2026-10-04, Claude, v2): grows with TIME spent digging without a pause, not per payout. Level n needs
-- COMBO_SECONDS * n^1.25 s (level 10 ~45 s, max level 20 = x2 Snow ~1 min 45 s); a COMBO_WINDOW pause resets it.
local COMBO_WINDOW, COMBO_STEP, COMBO_MAX, COMBO_SECONDS = 2.5, 0.05, 20, 2.5
local combos = {}
game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) combos[p] = nil end)

-- Snowplow mode (2026-10-04, Claude): the vehicle's blade clears the tiles it drives over. PlowConfig.Mode picks ONE digging path (see
-- collect); the other never runs, so a converted player cannot earn duplicate Snow or treasure rolls. Everything is computed here from
-- the server's own copy of the build, the replicated hull position and the clock - nothing the client reports.
local function payoutPlow(player, gained, layers, now)
	local pets = {}
	for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
	gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
	local c = combos[player] or {start = now, last = 0, count = 0}
	if now - c.last > COMBO_WINDOW then c.start = now end
	c.last = now
	c.count = math.min(COMBO_MAX, math.floor(((now - c.start) / COMBO_SECONDS) ^ 0.8))
	combos[player] = c
	local comboMult = 1 + c.count * COMBO_STEP
	gained = math.floor(gained * comboMult + 0.5)
	player:SetAttribute("Combo", c.count)
	DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
	collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained, c.count, layers, comboMult)
end
local function collectPlow(player, st, now)
	lastTime[player] = now
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return end
	local v = PlowRegistry.Active[player]
	if not v or not v.hull or not v.hull.Parent then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.SeatPart ~= v.seat then v.lastCF = nil return end
	local cf = v.hull.CFrame
	if (root.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude > PlowConfig.Vehicle.MaxRiderGap then v.lastCF = nil return end
	local prevCF, prevT = v.lastCF, v.lastT
	v.lastCF, v.lastT = cf, now
	if not prevCF then return end
	local dt = now - prevT
	if dt < 0.02 or dt > 1.2 then return end
	local move = Vector3.new(cf.X - prevCF.X, 0, cf.Z - prevCF.Z).Magnitude
	local stats, CL = v.stats, PlowConfig.Clearing
	if move / dt > stats.MaxSpeed * CL.SpeedTolerance + 8 then v.flags = (v.flags or 0) + 1 return end -- implausible movement: no clearing this tick
	if not stats.HasBlade or stats.ClearPower <= 0 then return end
	local W, off = stats.BladeWidth, PlowConfig.Vehicle.BladeOffset
	local half, halfD = W / 2 + TS * CL.TileSlack, CL.BladeDepth / 2 + TS * CL.TileSlack
	local K = math.clamp(math.ceil(move / (TS * 0.5)) + 1, 1, 12)
	local slice = dt / K
	local gained, layers = 0, 0
	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = cf.X - origin.X, cf.Z - origin.Z
		local m = W + off + 8
		if lx > -m and lz > -m and lx < f.Width * TS + m and lz < f.Depth * TS + m and math.abs(cf.Y - origin.Y) < 14 then
			local s = st[id]
			local tough = math.clamp((math.log10(maxHP) - CL.ToughLow) / CL.ToughSpan, 0, 1)
			local dmgPerSlice = stats.ClearPower * (stats.Soft + (stats.Hard - stats.Soft) * tough) * slice
			local contact = {}
			for k = 1, K do
				local c = prevCF:Lerp(cf, k / K)
				local lv = c.LookVector
				local fl = math.sqrt(lv.X * lv.X + lv.Z * lv.Z)
				if fl > 1e-3 then
					local fx, fz = lv.X / fl, lv.Z / fl
					local rx, rz = -fz, fx
					local cx, cz = c.X + fx * off - origin.X, c.Z + fz * off - origin.Z
					local hx = math.abs(rx) * half + math.abs(fx) * halfD
					local hz = math.abs(rz) * half + math.abs(fz) * halfD
					local x0, x1 = math.max(0, math.floor((cx - hx) / TS)), math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((cx + hx) / TS))
					local z0, z1 = math.max(0, math.floor((cz - hz) / TS)), math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((cz + hz) / TS))
					for x = x0, x1 do
						for z = z0, z1 do
							local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
							if s.phases[i] > 0 then
								local dx, dz = (x + 0.5) * TS - cx, (z + 0.5) * TS - cz
								if math.abs(dx * fx + dz * fz) <= halfD and math.abs(dx * rx + dz * rz) <= half then contact[i] = (contact[i] or 0) + 1 end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for i, n in pairs(contact) do
				local hp = s.hp[i] - dmgPerSlice * n
				local p = s.phases[i]
				while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do p -= 1; gained += f.SnowPerPhase; layers += 1; hp += maxHP end
				if p == 0 then
					hp = maxHP
					if Treasures then
						local x, z = (i - 1) % f.Width, math.floor((i - 1) / f.Width)
						local okT, errT = pcall(Treasures.TileCleared, player, f, SF.TileCenter(f, x, z))
						if not okT and not treasureWarned then treasureWarned = true; warn("[Treasures] " .. tostring(errT)) end
					end
				end
				s.phases[i] = p
				s.hp[i] = hp
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
	if gained > 0 then payoutPlow(player, gained, layers, now) end
end

local function collect(player, st, now)
	if PlowConfig.Mode == "Snowplow" then return collectPlow(player, st, now) end -- exactly one digging path per mode
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then lastTime[player]=now; return end
	local prev = lastTime[player]
	lastTime[player] = now
	if not prev then return end
	local powers, sizes = armPowers(player)
	local spd = SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1)
	local rOut = R_OUT * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)
	local maxSize = 1
	for _, sz in ipairs(sizes) do maxSize = math.max(maxSize, sz) end
	local rFar = HUB + (rOut - HUB) * maxSize -- furthest arm (Giant shovels reach further)
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	local n = #powers
	if n == 0 then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local sweep = math.min((now - prev) * spd, TWO_PI)
	local pos = root.Position
	local gained = 0
	local layers = 0

	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Z - origin.Z
		if lx > -rFar and lz > -rFar and lx < f.Width * TS + rFar and lz < f.Depth * TS + rFar
			and math.abs(pos.Y - origin.Y) < 9 then
			local s = st[id]
			local x0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lx - rFar) / TS))
			local x1 = math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((lx + rFar) / TS))
			local z0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lz - rFar) / TS))
			local z1 = math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((lz + rFar) / TS))
			for k = 0, n - 1 do
				local dmg = (powers[k + 1] + bonus) * pmult
				local a0 = prev * spd + k * (TWO_PI / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				local rArm = HUB + (rOut - HUB) * (sizes[k + 1] or 1)
				for x = x0, x1 do
					for z = z0, z1 do
						local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
						if s.phases[i] > 0 then
							local dx = origin.X + (x + 0.5) * TS - pos.X
							local dz = origin.Z + (z + 0.5) * TS - pos.Z
							local d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
							if d2 >= R_IN * R_IN and d2 <= rArm * rArm
								and (math.atan2(dz, dx) - a0) % TWO_PI <= sweep then
								local hp = s.hp[i] - dmg
								local p = s.phases[i]
								-- strong shovels can break several layers in one hit
								while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do
									p -= 1
									gained += f.SnowPerPhase
									layers += 1
									hp += maxHP
								end
								if p == 0 then
									hp = maxHP
									-- Buried Treasures (2026-10-01): a fully dug tile may hide a treasure (TreasureService decides)
									if Treasures then
										local okT, errT = pcall(Treasures.TileCleared, player, f, SF.TileCenter(f, x, z))
										if not okT and not treasureWarned then treasureWarned = true; warn("[Treasures] " .. tostring(errT)) end
									end
								end
								s.phases[i] = p
								s.hp[i] = hp
								s.pending[i] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if gained > 0 then
		-- equipped pets boost the snow you earn
		local pets = {}
		for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
		gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
		-- dig combo: +5% per step, x2 at the max; a 2.5 s pause resets it
		local c = combos[player] or {start = now, last = 0, count = 0}
		if now - c.last > COMBO_WINDOW then c.start = now end
		c.last = now
		c.count = math.min(COMBO_MAX, math.floor(((now - c.start) / COMBO_SECONDS) ^ 0.8))
		combos[player] = c
		local comboMult = 1 + c.count * COMBO_STEP
		gained = math.floor(gained * comboMult + 0.5)
		player:SetAttribute("Combo", c.count)
		DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
		collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained, c.count, layers, comboMult)
	end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

	end
end)

local function profile(player)

-- same multipliers SnowFieldService applies to dug Snow (pets x pet boosts x SnowMult incl. upgrades, rebirths, friends)
local function snowMultiplier(player)
	local pets = {}
	for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
	return (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1)
end

local function pickRarity()
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * TC.TotalWeight
	for _, rar in ipairs(TC.Rarities) do
		r -= rar.Weight
		if r <= 0 then return rar end
	end
	return TC.Rarities[1]
end

-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): fields are tougher (TileHP and SnowPerPhase x TileScale on each SnowStages stage), so a cleared tile rolls
-- TileScale x more often and a treasure's Snow bonus is divided by TileScale: treasures keep their old pace and value.
local function tileScale(field)
	local stages = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("SnowStages")
	local st = field and field.Style and stages and stages:FindFirstChild(field.Style)
	return math.max(1, (st and st:GetAttribute("TileScale")) or 1)
end

local function award(player, d, item, field, pos, guaranteed)
	local rar = TC.RarityById[item.Rarity]
	local tileSnow = ((field and field.SnowPerPhase) or 1) / tileScale(field) * SF.MaxPhase
	local bonus = math.max(1, math.floor(tileSnow * rar.Bonus * snowMultiplier(player) + 0.5))
	local count = (tonumber(d.Treasures[item.Id]) or 0) + 1
	local isNew = count == 1
	d.Treasures[item.Id] = count
	if isNew then d.TreasureNew[item.Id] = true end
	d.TreasureFound += 1
	DataService.AddSnow(player, bonus)
	player:SetAttribute("TreasuresFound", d.TreasureFound)
	foundEvent:FireClient(player, {Id = item.Id, New = isNew, Count = count, Snow = bonus, Pos = pos, First = guaranteed == true})
	if rar.Announce then
		for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = other ~= player and other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude <= TC.AnnounceRadius then
				foundEvent:FireClient(other, {Id = item.Id, Announce = true, Finder = player.DisplayName, Pos = pos})
			end
		end
	end
	return bonus
end

function T.TileCleared(player, field, pos)
	local d = profile(player)
	if not d then return end
	local biome = TC.BiomeFor(field and field.Style)
	if d.TreasureFound == 0 then
		d.TreasureDug += 1
		if d.TreasureDug >= TC.GuaranteeAfterTiles then
			award(player, d, biome.ByRarity.Common, field, pos, true)
			return
		end
	end
	if rng:NextNumber() >= math.min(0.5, TC.TileChance * tileScale(field)) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local r = recent[player]
	if not r or now - r.t > 1 then r = {t = now, n = 0}; recent[player] = r end
	if r.n >= TC.MaxPerSecond then return end
	r.n += 1
	award(player, d, biome.ByRarity[pickRarity().Id], field, pos, false)
end

-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): Frost King boss reward - one random treasure of that field's biome (normal rarity weights)
function T.GrantRandom(player, style, field)
	local d = profile(player)
	if not d then return nil end
	local biome = TC.BiomeFor(style)
	local item = biome and biome.ByRarity[pickRarity().Id]
	if not item then return nil end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pos = root and (root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 5 - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) or Vector3.zero
	award(player, d, item, field or {Style = style, SnowPerPhase = 1}, pos, false)
	return item
end

-- The server picks and grants the prize; WheelClient only animates. Stage unlocks are read from StageService's Stage_<Id>
-- attributes, so no other script changed. Profile: d.Wheel = {Spins, Total, Granted = {["<StageId>@<rebirths>"] = true}}.
-- Wheel Snow goes onto the balance but NOT into SnowEarned, so it doesn't count as digging (quests, achievements, dig speed).
-- Slices and weights: ReplicatedStorage.WheelConfig.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Boosts = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BoostService"))

local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local A = require(RS:WaitForChild("ActivityConfig"))
local W = require(RS:WaitForChild("WheelConfig"))
local NumberFormat = require(RS:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))

local fn = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
fn.Name = "WheelRemote"
fn.Parent = RS
local rng = Random.new()

local function nice(x) -- 2 significant digits, like the Daily rewards
	x = math.max(1, x)
	if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
	local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
	return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
end

local function wheelOf(d)
	local w = type(d.Wheel) == "table" and d.Wheel or {}
	w.Spins = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(w.Spins) or 0))
	w.Total = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(w.Total) or 0))
	if type(w.Granted) ~= "table" then w.Granted = {} end
	d.Wheel = w
	return w
end

local function snowFor(d, minutes) -- ActivityService keeps d.Activity.Rate = recent digging speed (Snow per second)
	local a = type(d.Activity) == "table" and d.Activity or {}
	return nice(math.max((W.MinSnowPerMinute or 50) * minutes, (tonumber(a.Rate) or 0) * 60 * minutes))
end

local function prizeInfo(d, s)
	if s.SnowMinutes then
		local amount = snowFor(d, s.SnowMinutes)
		local t = "+" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(amount)
		return {Kind = s.Jackpot and "Jackpot" or "Snow", Text = t, Sub = s.Jackpot and "JACKPOT!" or "SNOW", Long = t .. " Snow", Amount = amount}
	elseif s.Boost then
		local b = A.Boosts[s.Boost]
		local name = b and b.Name or s.Boost
		local mins = math.floor((s.Seconds or 0) / 60 + 0.5)
		return {Kind = s.Boost, Text = s.Boost == "Super" and "SUPER" or string.upper(name), Sub = mins .. " MIN", Long = name .. " for " .. mins .. " min"}
	end
	return {Kind = "?", Text = "?", Sub = "", Long = "?"}
end

local function prizes(d)
	local list = {}
	for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do list[i] = prizeInfo(d, s) end
	return list
end

local function publish(player, w) player:SetAttribute("WheelSpins", w.Spins) end

-- 1 spin for every stage you unlock (again after each rebirth). Free stages (Starter, Sakura) don't count.
local function check(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	local w = wheelOf(d)
	local rb = R.Count(d.Rebirths)
	for _, s in ipairs(Stages.Order) do
		if (s.Cost or 0) > 0 and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. s.Id) == true then
			local key = s.Id .. "@" .. rb
			if not w.Granted[key] then
				w.Granted[key] = true
				w.Spins += 1
				w.Total += 1
			end
		end
	end
	publish(player, w)
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	for _, s in ipairs(Stages.Order) do
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stage_" .. s.Id):Connect(function() check(player) end)
	end
	task.delay(1, check, player) -- stages already open (existing players get those spins once)
end)

local function pick()
	local total = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do total += math.max(0, s.Weight or 1) end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do
		r -= math.max(0, s.Weight or 1)
		if r <= 0 then return i end
	end
	return #W.Segments
end

local lastSpin = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastSpin[p] = nil end)

fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return nil end
	local w = wheelOf(d)
	if action == "Get" then
		return {Ok = true, Spins = w.Spins, Prizes = prizes(d)}
	elseif action == "Spin" then
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastSpin[player] and now - lastSpin[player] < (W.SpinSeconds or 4) then
			return {Ok = false, Msg = "The wheel is still spinning!", Spins = w.Spins}
		end
		if w.Spins <= 0 then
			return {Ok = false, Msg = "No spins left - unlock a new stage to get one!", Spins = 0}
		end
		lastSpin[player] = now
		local i = pick()
		local s = W.Segments[i]
		local info = prizeInfo(d, s)
		w.Spins -= 1
		if s.SnowMinutes then
			d.Snow = (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) + info.Amount
			DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
		elseif s.Boost then
			Boosts.Add(player, s.Boost, s.Seconds)
		end
		publish(player, w)
		return {Ok = true, Index = i, Prize = info, Spins = w.Spins, Prizes = prizes(d)}
	end
	return nil
end

local Players, SS, SSS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ServerStorage"), game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Registry = require(SSS.PlowRegistry)
local hook = SS:WaitForChild("PlowTestHook", 30)
local sv = SS:WaitForChild("TEMP_AutopilotText")
local p = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
local out = {}
local function say(s) table.insert(out, s); sv.Value = table.concat(out, "\n") end
local function run(label, target)
	if Registry.Active[p] then hook:Invoke(p, "Drive"); task.wait(1.2) end
	local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
	local dir0 = (Vector3.new(target.X, 0, target.Z) - Vector3.new(sp.Position.X, 0, sp.Position.Z)).Unit
	p.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(sp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), sp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) + dir0))
	task.wait(1.5)
	local r = hook:Invoke(p, "Drive")
	task.wait(1.5)
	local v = Registry.Active[p]
	if not (r.ok and v) then say(label .. ": could not drive: " .. tostring(r.msg)) return end
	local hull = v.hull
	local t0, stuckFor, stuckEvents, reverseUntil, reverseSteer = os.clock(), 0, 0, 0, 1
	local causes = {}
	local best = math.huge
	while os.clock() - t0 < 70 do
		task.wait(0.1)
		local pos = hull.Position
		local to = Vector3.new(target.X - pos.X, 0, target.Z - pos.Z)
		local dist = to.Magnitude
		best = math.min(best, dist)
		if dist < 12 then say(("%s: REACHED the field in %.1f s (%d stuck events)%s"):format(label, os.clock() - t0, stuckEvents, #causes > 0 and (" | blockers: " .. table.concat(causes, "; ")) or "")) break end
		local lv = hull.CFrame.LookVector
		local L, D = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z).Unit, to.Unit
		local s = L:Cross(D).Y
		local steer = -math.clamp(s * 3, -1, 1)
		if L:Dot(D) < 0 then steer = s >= 0 and -1 or 1 end
		local vel = hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local speed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		if os.clock() < reverseUntil then
			p:SetAttribute("PlowTestMove", Vector3.new(reverseSteer, 0, 1))
		else
			p:SetAttribute("PlowTestMove", Vector3.new(steer, 0, -1))
			if os.clock() - t0 > 2 and speed < 2.5 then stuckFor += 0.1 else stuckFor = 0 end
			if stuckFor > 0.7 then
				stuckEvents += 1; stuckFor = 0
				reverseUntil = os.clock() + 1.1; reverseSteer = (stuckEvents % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
				local ov = OverlapParams.new(); ov.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; ov.FilterDescendantsInstances = {v.model, p.Character}
				for _, q in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(hull.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -4.4), Vector3.new(6, 2.2, 2.4), ov)) do
					if q.CanCollide and #causes < 8 then
						local nm = q.Name .. "@" .. (q.Parent and q.Parent.Name or "?")
						if not table.find(causes, nm) then table.insert(causes, nm) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	p:SetAttribute("PlowTestMove", nil)
	if (out[#out] or ""):sub(1, #label) ~= label then say(("%s: DID NOT REACH it in 70 s - closest %.0f studs, %d stuck events | blockers: %s"):format(label, best, stuckEvents, #causes > 0 and table.concat(causes, "; ") or "-")) end
end

-- SNOW FIELDS
-- Fields are placed in Studio as boxes inside Workspace > SnowFieldZones.
--   * Move / resize the box: the bottom of the box is the ground level of the field.
--   * Size is snapped to whole tiles (TileSize studs). Rotation is ignored (fields are axis-aligned).
--   * Attributes on the box: DisplayName, SnowPerPhase, RegrowSeconds.
-- When the game starts the server reads the boxes, removes them, and shares the field data with clients.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SnowFields = {}

SnowFields.TileSize = 3
SnowFields.MaxPhase = 3
-- tile look & heights come from ReplicatedStorage > SnowFieldStyles
SnowFields.Spinner = {Speed = 7, Inner = 1.0, Outer = 5.3} -- Speed MUST match the visual spin
SnowFields.Defaults = {SnowPerPhase = 1, RegrowSeconds = 8}

function SnowFields.Origin(f)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return f.Center - Vector3.new(f.Width * ts / 2, 0, f.Depth * ts / 2)
end

function SnowFields.TileCenter(f, x, z)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return SnowFields.Origin(f) + Vector3.new((x + 0.5) * ts, 0, (z + 0.5) * ts)
end

local function readZones()
	local list, used = {}, {}
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if not zones then return list end
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	for i, z in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if z:IsA("BasePart") then
			local id = z.Name
			if used[id] then id = id .. "_" .. i end
			used[id] = true
			table.insert(list, {
				Id = id,
				Name = z:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or z.Name,
				Center = Vector3.new(z.Position.X, z.Position.Y - z.Size.Y / 2, z.Position.Z),
				Width = math.max(1, math.floor(z.Size.X / ts + 0.5)),
				Depth = math.max(1, math.floor(z.Size.Z / ts + 0.5)),
				SnowPerPhase = z:GetAttribute("SnowPerPhase") or SnowFields.Defaults.SnowPerPhase,
				RegrowSeconds = z:GetAttribute("RegrowSeconds") or SnowFields.Defaults.RegrowSeconds,
				Style = z:GetAttribute("Style") or "Default",
			})
		end
	end
	return list
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	SnowFields.Fields = readZones()
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "SnowFieldData"
		for _, f in ipairs(SnowFields.Fields) do
			local c = Instance.new("Configuration")
			c.Name = f.Id
			for k, v in pairs(f) do c:SetAttribute(k, v) end
			c.Parent = folder
		end
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
		if zones then zones:Destroy() end
	end
else
	SnowFields.Fields = {}
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldData")
	for _, c in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(SnowFields.Fields, c:GetAttributes())
	end
end

return SnowFields

local Builder = {}

local SP, METAL, WOOD, NEON, GLASS, ICE = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.Material.Glass, Enum.Material.Ice
local BASALT, SAND, MARBLE, FOIL = Enum.Material.Basalt, Enum.Material.Sand, Enum.Material.Marble, Enum.Material.Foil
local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function rgb(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local PI = math.pi
local TOP = -0.74 -- where the blade starts

--------------------------------------------------
-- PRIMITIVES
--------------------------------------------------
local M -- model being built
local function part(name, size, cf, color, mat, props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	if props and props.Shape then p.Shape = props.Shape end
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or SP
	p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CanTouch = false
	p.Massless = true; p.CastShadow = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Shape" then p[k] = v end end end
	p.Parent = M
	return p
end
local function ball(name, d, pos, color, mat, props)
	props = props or {}
	props.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	return part(name, Vector3.new(d, d, d), CFrame.new(pos), color, mat, props)
end
local function wedge(name, size, cf, color, mat, props)
	local w = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	w.Name = name; w.Size = size; w.CFrame = cf; w.Color = color; w.Material = mat or SP
	w.Anchored = true; w.CanCollide = false; w.CanQuery = false; w.CanTouch = false; w.Massless = true; w.CastShadow = false
	if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do w[k] = v end end
	w.Parent = M
	return w
end
-- flat isosceles triangle in the blade plane; base centered at (bx,by), apex at distance h in direction ang
local function tri(name, bx, by, z, ang, hw, h, thick, color, mat, props)
	local base = CFrame.new(bx, by, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang - PI / 2)
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
		wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, h, hw), base * CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(s * hw / 2, h / 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, s), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), color, mat, props)
	end
end
-- 3D spike (two crossed blades); Y axis of cf = spike direction
local function spike(name, cf, h, hw, color, mat, props)
	for b = 0, 1 do
		local bcf = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, b * PI / 2, 0)
		for s = 0, 1 do
			local c = bcf * CFrame.new(0, h / 2, s == 0 and -hw / 2 or hw / 2)
			if s == 1 then c = c * CFrame.Angles(0, PI, 0) end
			wedge(name, Vector3.new(hw * 0.9, h, hw), c, color, mat, props)
		end
	end
end
local function emitter(p, kind, color)

	e.LightEmission = 1

	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)

	elseif kind == "Fire" then

		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
		e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	elseif kind == "Smoke" then
